description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the Account controller class within the Opencart CMS, specifically for the 'catalog' section. It handles user account pages, including routing, session validation, and rendering the account view.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Controller class for user account management, including rendering the account dashboard, handling authorization, and managing account-related data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the account page. Checks user login status, handles redirection if necessary, sets page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, loads various account-related URLs, and renders the account view template.
